sources.title: Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct-bnb-4bit: Text-to-Text model — overview, use ...
sources.snippet: Overview Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct-bnb-4bit is a quantized version of Microsoft's Phi-3 mini language model, prepared by unsloth for efficient fine-tuning and inference on consumer hardware. The model operates with a 4,096 token context window and uses 4-bit quantization via bitsandbytes to reduce memory requirements while preserving performance.

sources.snippet: The model belongs to the Phi-3 family with the Mini version in two variants 4K and 128K which is the context length (in tokens) that it can support. The model has underwent a post-training process that incorporates both supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization for the instruction following and safety measures.
